name: STOCK METER READING
description: The value of a STOCK METER recorded at a particular time for a particular reason.

name: STORE FINANCIAL LEDGER
description: Ledger account for tracking Store financial information including ACCOUNT CERTIFICATEs and CUSTOMER ACCOUNTs.

description: A repository within the enterprise for safekeeping of TENDER removed from the Till and or Tills. This includes: ■ Safe ■ LockBox ■ SecureLocation

description: A transaction that records closing of the ledger for the STORE SAFE. A new TRANSACTION ledger will be opened with a new beginning on hand accountability, and zero incremental accumulators (pickup, loan, deposit, and so on).

name: STORE WORKSTATION
description: Device used as an Interface to any retail business function. For example, the capture and storage of RETAIL TRANSACTIONs and operational performance reporting. Usually a cash register.

name: SUB BRAND
description: A subcomponent of a BRAND. For example, if a BRAND were "Super Cola", the subbrand might be "Super Cola Light".

name: SUB REGION
description: A level in the Geography hierarchy below REGION.

name: SUBSCRIPTION
description: The record of CUSTOMER using a product or service which may be based on a contract. CUSTOMER’s subscription to services is the basis of billing and network usage authorization.

name: SURVEY
description: Survey conducted by or of interest to the retailer.

name: SURVEY COST
description: Subtype of COST for tracking the cost of conducting or buying survey.

name: SURVEY QUESTION
description: A question in a SURVEY.

name: SURVEY QUESTION OPTION
description: An option in a SURVEY QUESTION.

name: SURVEY RESPONSE DETAIL
description: Response details to SURVEY QUESTIONs.

name: SURVEY RESPONSE HEADER

name: TANK
description: A kind of LOCATION used to store a FUEL ITEM that is measured and dispensed by one or more FUELING POINTs.

name: TANK LEVEL GAUGE
description: A piece of equipment that takes measurements from TANK PROBEs to report the amount of fuel in TANK.

name: TANK PROBE
description: A device that is housed in the TANK and periodically (or on demand) returns height (and/or volume) readings to the TANK LEVEL GAUGE to which it is connected.

name: TANK READING
description: A reading of the height, and or volumes, of Fuel and Water measurements of the contents of a TANK.

name: TANK TEMPERATURE
description: A reading of the temperature of the Fuel that is stored in a TANK. READING

name: TANK TEMPERATURE SENSOR
description: A device that is housed in the TANK and periodically (or on demand) returns temperature readings for the FUEL ITEM that is stored there.

name: TARE
description: Defines the weight of the container that must be subtracted from the gross weight to calculate net selling weight for items priced and purchased in weight UNIT OF MEASURE.

name: TARGET
description: Type of CAMPAIGN MESSAGE RENDERING containing the message target list or time slot.

name: TASK
description: An individual activity that a Worker performs for their POSITION.

name: TASK PREREQUISITE
description: A qualification or certificate that a person must hold to be allowed to perform a particular TASK.

name: TASK SET
description: A group of activities that a Worker performs for their Job. 2-86 Oracle Retail Data Model Reference

name: TAX AUTHORITY
description: A government authority that levies sales taxes and on whose behalf the store collects these sales taxes. For example: ■ National ■ State ■ Province ■ City ■ County ■ Other

name: TAX EXEMPTION
description: An CUSTOMER ORGANIZATION whose purchases are exempt from sales tax.

name: TAX GROUP RULE
description: A rule that prescribes how a particular tax is to be applied to a group Items.

name: TAX LEVEL TYPE
description: A categorization of tax levels that describe whether the results of the tax rule apply to the individual items, a multi-component item, or the entire transaction.

name: TAX LINE ITEM
description: A line item component of a RETAIL TRANSACTION that records the charging and offsetting liability credit for sales tax on merchandise items and services sold by the store or debit for merchandise returned to the store.

name: TAX LINE ITEM AUDIT
description: Audited TAX LINE ITEMs.

name: TAX RATE CLASS
description: A classification of Tax Rates. For example: ■ Standard ■ Reduced ■ Luxury

name: TAX RATE RULE
description: A rule denoting what percentage or dollar amount of tax is applied to a particular taxable total in a RETAIL TRANSACTION.

name: TAX RESULT TYPE
description: A classification of tax results. For example: ■ Taxable ■ Exempt ■ Zero-Rated

name: TAX THRESHOLD TYPE
description: A categorization of how to process a tax if an when a stated threshold established for the taxable amount is reached, such as: ■ Exempt Entire Amount ■ Tax Entire Amount ■ Tax Only Amount above Threshold

name: TAX TYPE
description: A kind of tax for which a PARTY is registered, and the retail enterprise pays to the TAX AUTHORITY on behalf of a Tax Jurisdiction. For example: ■ SalesTax ■ GST ■ PST ■ HST ■ VAT

name: TAXABLE GROUP
description: A group of ITEMs for which a TAX AUTHORITY defines TAX GROUP RULEs. For example: ■ Food items ■ Hard goods

name: TENDER
description: Tender includes all the forms of payment that are accepted by the ORGANIZATION STORE in settling sales and other transactions.

name: TENDER ACCOUNT APPROVAL
description: Repository of external account numbers against which an individual tender can REFERENCE be approved or rejected depending on the status of that account.

name: TENDER ADJUSTMENT
description: A type of TENDER CONTROL TRANSACTION that records the transformation of TRANSACTION TENDER from one Tender Type to another within a Till.

name: TENDER AUTHORIZATION
description: A request to an external agency to authorize the use of some form of TENDER to complete a RETAIL TRANSACTION. For example: ■ Checks ■ Credit and Debit Cards ■ Gift Certificates ■ Vouchers

name: TENDER AUTHORIZATION
description: A request to an external agency to reverse a previously requested authorization REVERSAL of the use of some form of tender to complete a RETAIL TRANSACTION. For example: ■ Checks ■ Credit and Debit Cards ■ Gift Certificates ■ Vouchers

name: TENDER CLASS

name: TENDER CONTROL

name: TENDER CONTROL

name: TENDER DEPOSIT

name: TENDER EXCHANGE
description: A type of TENDER CONTROL TRANSACTION that records the movement of TRANSACTION TENDER between two Tills.

name: TENDER LINE ITEM
description: Records the Denominations used in a particular TenderLineItem. DENOMINATION

name: TENDER LOAN TRANSACTION
description: A type of TENDER CONTROL TRANSACTION that records the movement of TENDER from a STORE SAFE to a Till.

name: TENDER PICKUP
description: A type of TENDER CONTROL TRANSACTION that records the movement of TRANSACTION TENDER from a Till to a STORE SAFE.

name: TENDER REPOSITORY
description: Describes the types of physical tender containers used in the retail enterprise. Tender repository generally includes assets like, store safe(s), tills, and so on.

name: TENDER REPOSITORY CLASS
description: Type of TENDER REPOSITORY. For example: ■ Safe ■ Till

name: TENDER REPOSITORY

name: TERM CODE

name: TERMS MASTER
description: Master data of terms of business with the VENDOR.

name: TEST DELIVERY
description: A type of transaction that records the clearing of a FUELING TRANSACTION without accepting payment because the fueling transaction was for testing or calibrating the FUELING POINT. The fuel delivered may or may not have been put back into a storage TANK.

name: TILL DERIVED

name: TILL HISTORY
description: A collection of monetary and operational totals used to track the activity volume of a till between Till Settlement Transactions.

description: A non-sales transaction recording the fact that the calculated cash on hand in a TRANSACTION particular Till has exceeded a pre-defined limit.

name: TILL LIMIT RULE
description: A rule defining an amount of Cash that is allowed to be held in a Till at any one time, and the action the POS Application is to take when the calculated amount of cash in exceeds the limit.

name: TILL LIMIT TYPE
description: A mnemonic code that denotes which of the limits in the TILL LIMIT RULE have been exceeded. For example: ■ Warning ■ Lockout

name: TILL MOVEMENT DIRECTION
description: A code denoting the direction the Till is being moved. That is, from STORE SAFE to STORE WORKSTATION, from STORE WORKSTATION to STORE SAFE, from STORE SAFE to Operator, or from Operator to STORE WORKSTATION, and so on.

name: TILL MOVEMENT
description: A non-sales transaction that records the physical movement of a Till (cash TRANSACTION drawer insert) from a STORE WORKSTATION to a STORE SAFE or from a STORE SAFE to a STORE WORKSTATION.

name: TILL OPERATOR
description: A non-sales transaction that records the assignment of a Till (cash drawer ASSIGNMENT TRANSACTION insert) to a specific operator.

name: TILL TAX HISTORY
description: A collection of tax totals for a tax authority by till for a tender reconciliation period.

name: TILL TENDER HISTORY

name: TILL TENDER LIMIT RULE
description: The assignment of a particular TILL LIMIT RULE to a Till for a nominated ASSIGNMENT type of TENDER during particular time periods.

name: TILL WORKSTATION
description: A permanent or temporary assignment of a Till to a particular STORE ASSIGNMENT WORKSTATION, recording where the Till was located for a particular period.

name: TIME PUNCH TRANSACTION

name: TIME STANDARD BY WEEK
description: Associates a CALENDAR WEEK to a SEASON.

name: TIME ZONE
description: Time zone relative to Greenwich Mean Time (GMT).

description: A type of TENDER CONTROL TRANSACTION that records the payment of TENDER from a Till to an EMPLOYEE as a payment of Tips due to them.

name: TONE INDICATOR

description: Represents the top most level of Time. This is needed to enable Ad-Hoc Reporting involving the Time Dimension.

description: A sub-type of TenderLineItem for retailers who accept various goods in part-payment for merchandise. For example, retailers give one hundred dollars in credit for an old (working) appliance, when purchasing a new similar appliance.

description: Further classifications of TRANSACTION CATEGORY.

description: A type of non-sales Transaction that changes the state of a STORE WORKSTATION from an inaccessible (locked) state to an accessible (unlocked) state for entering transactions.

description: Unit of measure for the value. For example a customer or a profile can be valued in terms of monetary value or time (a customer for next three years).

description: The type of value. For example: ■ Time ■ Money

name: VARIETY
description: User Defined Item attribute other than size, weight, and style, such as color.

name: VARIETY TYPE
description: Captures all the variety type. For example: ■ Color ■ Shape

name: VENDOR
description: External source for merchandise and goods that the ORGANIZATION STORE offers or for supplies and goods that the retail organization uses. ■ Vendor site: Vendor location.

description: Details of vendor appointments. Vendor appointments are regular visits by the vendor's representative to the ORGANIZATION STORE.
